_meta.paths: still / still1920 / storeys.*.mask are relative to public/demo/ (served at /demo/...)
_meta.coords: still pixels of THIS camera (w x h, origin top-left, y down); scale by displayed width / w
_meta.storeys: ids as public/data/floors.json: garden (= model level basement), ground, 1, 2, 3, roof; order = bottom-up
_meta.poly: hit-test multipolygon: a list of rings [[x, y], ...] (outer contours, no holes) from the UNOCCLUDED render (trees, lamps, hedges, neighbours removed); the rings tile the building, neighbours share their border (1-2 px overlap)
_meta.mask: soft alpha PNG (mode LA, white + alpha) of the storey AS SEEN in the still (occluders cut it), cropped to maskRect = [x, y, w, h] in still pixels; place it at maskRect over the still
_meta.cardAnchor: the storey's right edge at its mid height (cardAnchorLeft = left edge); center = a label point inside the visible part
_meta.glow: (v13, owner item 27b) the storey glow on the VIEWED FACADE only: glow = soft alpha PNG of the storey facade faces (normal within ~37 deg of the facade normal, in the facade plane band, not vegetation) as seen, at glowRect; glowPoly = its facade outline (the rim + bloom); facadeClip = the whole viewed facade (the bloom is clipped to it); facadeGeo = the numbers
_meta.membership: what lifts out in the explode (motion_rig.py): level_<id> subtree; facade + olives + roof shrubs -> roof; balcony plants -> their storey; stairs_<up> -> the storey below; LED coves under a slab -> the storey above
